meta.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA), via Earth Search STAC (Element 84)
meta.method: Water = scene-classification water, or NDWI > 0, or MNDWI > 0.1, inside the mapped outline at 10 m; single-pixel gaps filled; up to 3 clearest scenes per month (each with at most 3 % cloud, shadow or missing pixels), keeping the wettest; run = longest straight chord, measured at each clear corridor width listed in widths
